texts: Connect to AutoTune on a TV or PC
AutoTune measures your car or room with a microphone and fits an EQ that brings it to a target sound.
Connect to AutoTune on a TV or PC
Put the mic where you sit. AutoTune plays a sweep and listens to your speakers.
Connect to AutoTune on a TV or PC
It compares the reading with a target curve and fits an EQ to close the gap.
Connect to AutoTune on a TV or PC
Measure again with the EQ on. The reading shows how close you are to the target.
Connect to AutoTune on a TV or PC
Save the EQ. It plays on the whole phone and can switch on when your car connects.
